data.title: Fun Counting Practice
data.description: You will count pictures out loud and tell how many there are.
data.gradeLevel: kindergarten students (ages 5-6) - Use clear language, relatable examples, foundational skills, and engaging visuals. Encourage exploration and basic problem-solving.

items.ask: Count the stars out loud. How many stars are there?
items.howToPlay: Count the pictures, then say how many out loud.
items.acceptRule: Counting aloud in order that ends on the number four counts as the correct answer.
items.signatureError: Just naming a random number like five without counting is not the total.
items.correctionBody: Let's count them together: one, two, three, four. There are four stars.

actionContract.label: Count and Say
actionContract.instruction: Count the stars out loud. How many stars are there?

items.ask: Count the apples out loud. How many apples are there?
items.howToPlay: Count the pictures, then say how many out loud.
items.acceptRule: Counting aloud in order that ends on the number nine counts as the correct answer.
items.signatureError: Repeating the last number counted too early, like eight, is not the total.
items.correctionBody: Let's touch and count: one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine. There are nine apples.

actionContract.label: Count and Say
actionContract.instruction: Count the apples out loud. How many apples are there?

items.ask: Count the swimming fish out loud. How many fish are there?
items.howToPlay: Count the pictures, then say how many out loud.
items.acceptRule: Counting aloud in order that ends on the number eight counts as the correct answer.
items.signatureError: Stopping early or skipping a number when counting means the total is wrong.
items.correctionBody: Let's count them one by one: one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight. There are eight fish.

actionContract.label: Count and Say
actionContract.instruction: Count the swimming fish out loud. How many fish are there?

items.ask: Count the blocks out loud. How many blocks are there?
items.howToPlay: Count the pictures, then say how many out loud.
items.acceptRule: Counting aloud in order that ends on the number three counts as the correct answer.
items.signatureError: Saying a number higher than three when there are only three blocks is not correct.
items.correctionBody: Let's count them carefully: one, two, three. There are three blocks.

actionContract.label: Count and Say
actionContract.instruction: Count the blocks out loud. How many blocks are there?
